description: Research software, full original notebook/source history, compact scored records, authenticated raw preparation inputs, pinned pretrained snapshots and 132 fitted checkpoints for enhancer benchmark overlap, grouped classification, lentiMPRA training adequacy and DHS-natural transfer. Reporting and headline statistics are reproducible from bundled predictions; separate commands rebuild raw datasets, perform fitted-checkpoint inference and opt into the frozen training studies. Historical baselines and hardware-specific validation limits are documented in the repository. Previously examined cohorts are not fresh confirmatory tests.
